name: article2cover-design
title_zh: 文章封面从策略到出图一条龙，两个分身接力不串台
tagline_zh: 写公众号/小红书封面，总在「想表达什么」和「怎么画出来」之间来回拉扯？它把策略和出图拆给两个隔离分身，各自专注。
tagline_en: Tired of bouncing between 'what to say' and 'how to draw it' for WeChat/XHS covers? This splits strategy and.
desc_en: Orchestrate a complete article-to-cover-strategy-to-Codex-ImageGen workflow by running the cover editorial and cover media skills sequentially in separate isolated subagents against one shared project. Use for article cover design and complete WeChat or Xiaohongshu cover delivery; use the stage skills directly for prompt-only or media-only work.
why_zh: 每个分身只干一件事，上下文不互相污染；策略定稿后才动笔出图，避免边想边画导致风格漂移。适合封面要过审。
why_en: Each subagent does one job, so context never bleeds. Image-gen starts only after strategy locks, preventing style drift. Built.
limit_zh: 只产出封面图，不含正文排版或配图素材库。需要 Codex 图像生成环境；若你只想要 prompt 或只想要图。
limit_en: Outputs cover image only—no article layout or asset library. Requires Codex image-gen. For prompt-only or media-only, call the stage skills.
title_en: Article cover: strategy to image, two agents relay
